verdict.rationale: Stable is a SaaS virtual-mailbox and registered-agent platform, so shipping an official CLI is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence documents only a REST API with x-api-key authentication, webhooks, a dashboard and an llms.txt file. Nothing in the pack mentions an official command-line tool, and the API and webhooks are developer building blocks, not a CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
